title: Null-text Inversion for Editing Real Images using Guided Diffusion Models
layout_note: Two titled panels stacked and divided by a dashed horizontal rule - 'DDIM Inversion' (the whole trajectory) above, 'Pivotal Tuning by Null-text Optimization' (one step) below - with a column of three photos at the right edge spanning both.
grouping: A grey dashed horizontal rule splits the two panels, each with a centred title; the photo column at the right is unframed and labelled under each photo (Input Image, Initial Inversion, Final Inversion).
shapes_depth: Latents are filled dots: dark grey for the inversion trajectory z*_T..z*_0, lighter grey for the tuned trajectory z-bar. The diffusion model is a flat grey hourglass (U-Net) silhouette labelled DM, drawn twice. Operators are circled x and +. The null-text embedding is a symbol inside a red circular 'tuning' arrow; the loss L_MSE is a red dashed arrow. No boxes, no shadows.
proposed_highlight: Red marks the optimised parts only: the circular 'tuning' arrow around the null-text embedding and the red dashed L_MSE arrow to the pivot z*_{t-1}.
lesson: Mark the only optimised variable with a circular red 'tuning' arrow around it, and draw its loss as a red dashed arrow to the target it is pulled toward, leaving everything frozen in grey and black.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v1 first page states no venue; the candidate list gives CVPR 2023 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. flow 'mixed': the top trajectory runs right to left (inversion) and returns left to right along the tuned path; the bottom panel runs left to right. refs crop records 23 embedded raster pieces in this crop: the three photos plus many wide strips across the drawing, so photo_share counts more than the photos and the measured palette covers only the rest.

arrangement.units: two panels stacked under centred titles and split by a dashed rule (whole-trajectory inversion above, one-step null-text optimisation below), plus an unframed column of three photos at the right
arrangement.inputs_as: a real photo ('Input Image') at the top of the right column; in the bottom panel a quoted caption and a quoted empty null-text at the left
arrangement.losses_at: the red dashed L_MSE arrow at the right of the bottom panel, from the step output z-bar_{t-1} up to the pivot z*_{t-1}
arrangement.shared: the diffusion model is drawn twice as identical grey DM hourglasses, one for the caption branch, one for the null-text branch

taxonomy.task: inverting a real image into a text-guided diffusion model for editing, by optimising the unconditional (null-text) embedding per timestep around a DDIM-inversion pivot
taxonomy.note: training 'other': per-image optimisation of the null-text embedding at each timestep; the model weights stay fixed.

insights.structure: The whole-trajectory view sits above a one-step detail, split by a dashed rule, with the input and two reconstructions as a photo column down the right edge.
insights.data: Latents are dots along a trajectory, the caption and the empty null-text are quoted, and the input and its reconstructions are real photos.
insights.emphasis: Red is reserved for what is optimised: the circular tuning arrow around the null-text embedding and the dashed L_MSE arrow.
insights.flow: The top panel runs right to left along the DDIM inversion pivots, then the tuned trajectory steps back left to right below it on dashed grey arrows; the bottom panel runs left to right into a weighted sum and up to the pivot.
insights.avoid: The bottom panel is tied to the top only by shared symbols (z-bar_t, z*_{t-1}), and the photo column is not connected to either panel by any line.

core.what: the DDIM inversion trajectory unrolled as a row of dark dots z*_T..z*_0 with the tuned trajectory z-bar as lighter dots stepping below it, each tuned step tied up to its pivot

relations.form: a row of pivot dots joined by solid leftward arrows with ellipses for the middle steps, and a second row of lighter dots below on dashed arrows
the step output z-bar_{t-1} sits directly under the pivot z*_{t-1}, joined by a red dashed L_MSE arrow; in the top panel one vertical arrow labelled 'Pivotal tuning' ties z-bar_1 to z*_1
the caption branch and the null-text branch each pass through a DM hourglass; their outputs are scaled by w and 1-w at circled x signs and meet at one + circle
the lower panel expands one step t of the upper trajectory, separated by a dashed rule and linked only by the shared symbols
Input Image, Initial Inversion and Final Inversion photos stacked in one right-hand column at the same size

channels.colour: red = optimised (the tuning arrow and the MSE loss); dark vs light grey dots = pivot trajectory vs tuned trajectory; grey = the frozen diffusion model; one meaning each
channels.shape: dots = latents, grey hourglass = the diffusion model, circles = operators, quoted text = text conditions
channels.line: solid arrows = DDIM inversion and forward computation; grey dashed arrows = the tuned trajectory; red dashed arrow = the loss; red circular arrow = per-step tuning
channels.frame: no frames; a dashed horizontal rule separates the two panels

quality.strengths: The pivot trajectory and the tuned trajectory are drawn as two rows of dots, so what is compared is visible; red is reserved for the one optimised variable and its loss; the two DM copies are identical silhouettes, so the classifier-free-guidance pair reads at a glance; the compared photos (input, initial, final inversion) are drawn at the same size.
quality.weaknesses: The tuned trajectory zig-zags down and back with dashed arrows of mixed directions; the one-step panel is tied to the trajectory only by symbols, not by a callout or tint; the photo column is unconnected to either panel; only one of the T pivot links is labelled 'Pivotal tuning'.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
